name: Port the asset generator to Nox
body:
The Rust `tools/asset-gen` (D-008) was deleted with the Rust workspace (D-208), so the placeholder textures, sounds, music and gem.glb can't be rebuilt. Port it to a Nox project (`mist run assets`, with `--check`), producing the same files byte for byte where the committed ones came from it.

Outcome: the Nox tool's output is the new source of truth. Sounds are identical sample for sample and textures pixel for pixel; the PNGs are stored blocks (larger), and gem.glb differs in the last bit of a few normals and in the generator name, so byte-for-byte parity with the Rust files was not kept (D-219).
